description.value: Thurga Grocery is a Sri Lankan and South Indian supermarket that has been serving Metro Vancouver for over 25 years, founded by Thulasi who immigrated from Sri Lanka and saw a gap in the local market for authentic South Asian goods. The store stocks fresh produce, traditional spices, and exotic fruits sourced from India and Sri Lanka, along with the owner's own branded Thurga products. Freshly made traditional Sri Lankan meals are also available on-site, making it a worthwhile stop for a hot meal.
